label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to tell discernment from confirmation-seeking, and answer honestly whether you need more information or more courage.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If decisions large and small keep becoming impossible, or you cannot act without certainty that a choice is God's will, a professional who understands obsessive symptoms can help. That is not weak faith.

label: Key Scripture
h: "If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach, and it will be given him."

label: Meet Rebecca
h:
Three weeks. Everyone said go.
The offer expired. She had wanted to go from day one.

label: Name The Pattern · Confirmation-Seeking
body:
DiscernmentUses the ordinary means. Gathers what can reasonably be gathered. Then decides.
Confirmation-seekingUses the same means and cannot stop. Asks one more person. Reads signs in both directions.

It is not seeking guidance. It is seeking the removal of risk, and guidance cannot provide that.

label: A Common Belief · "God Has One Right Choice, And If I Miss It I Am Outside His Will"
body:
God is not a cruel examiner who condemns sincere believers for failing to decode a hidden message.
God's providence is larger than our decisions. He led, corrected and used people who chose badly.
Many decisions are between permissible options, where Scripture leaves real freedom to choose wisely.

label: Four Faithful Responses
body:
ActYou already have what you need.
WaitA real reason, and an end.
Seek helpExpertise you do not have. Bounded.
SurrenderNot yours to decide, or all is done.

label: The Tool · One Honest Question
h: What information is genuinely missing, and what courage will still be required after I have it?
body: What you want is relevant information, not divine authorisation. The overthinker often discounts it entirely.

label: Then Answer Which Fits
body:
I need specific informationName what is missing, where it can be found, by when. Get it.
I have enough. I need courageFurther discernment is adding nothing. Deciding is now an act of faith.
I need bothGet the information, knowing the courage will still be required after.

label: Do This Now
h: Take one decision you have been circling. Write which you need: information, courage, or both.
body:
If information: name it and the date you will have it. If courage: write what you actually want to do.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: God promised wisdom, not a guarantee. Deciding is an act of faith.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, I have asked for wisdom,
and I trust that you are giving it.

This is what I intend to do.

If it proves unwise, you will remain faithful.
Give me humility to see it, and to respond.

Amen.
